title: GEOMLAMA: Geo-Diverse Commonsense Probing on Multilingual Pre-Trained Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for geo-diverse commonsense probing and analyzes bias in pre-trained language models, but it does not evaluate models on religion, morals, or ethics.
